summary: This PR adds a user search endpoint but contains critical security vulnerabilities: an SQL injection via f-string query formatting and a hardcoded secret API key.

findings.title: SQL Injection vulnerability
findings.explanation: User input from the 'query' parameter is directly interpolated into an SQL query string using an f-string without parameterization or escaping. This allows arbitrary SQL injection (e.g., `' OR '1'='1`).
findings.suggested_fix: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE ?', (f'%{query}%',))

findings.title: Hardcoded secret API key
findings.explanation: A static API credential ('sk-1234567890abcdef') is hardcoded directly in application source code. Credentials must be loaded from environment variables and never committed to source control.
